title: Delete your ChaiShots account
intro_p1: You can request deletion of your ChaiShots account and all associated personal data at any time. This ensures your privacy and control over your personal information.
intro_p2: To request deletion, email our support team using the button below. We'll verify your request through your registered email or phone before completing the deletion. This keeps your account secure and ensures authenticity.
intro_p3: Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone. Once processed, your profile and activity history will be permanently erased, with personal data removed except where legal obligations require us to retain certain records.
cta_subtext: Click below to email support. We process requests within 30 days.
bullet1: Your account and activity will be erased.
bullet2: Some data may be retained to meet legal requirements.
